⚡ Power

Wood Generator
!build wood_generator
★ 170 pts
Burns wood to generate power.
1x Wood → ⚡ 250 Power every 60s
💰 10x Stone + 20x Iron Plate
🔧 Repair: 1x Repair Pack
🏗️ Build: 10s
Coal Generator
!build coal_generator
★ 255 pts
Burns coal to generate power.
1x Coal → ⚡ 500 Power every 60s
💰 15x Stone + 30x Iron Plate
🔧 Repair: 1x Repair Pack
🏗️ Build: 10s
